subject: Post-call: StratoCloud partner handoff + propose demo windows

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: StratoCloud partner handoff + propose demo windows

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the intro call earlier. Quick recap from our side and suggested next steps so we can lock in a partner-led technical deep dive: 

Key points I heard today:
- StratoCloud is exploring Redwood for embedded inference across marketplace-managed accounts and wants a carrier-grade SLA and usage isolation for pilot customers.
- Primary workloads: multi-tenant embeddings + real-time chat for search assistants (10–20 req/s peak).
- Top concerns: data residency, audit logs, and an integration path for marketplace billing.

Our recommended next step:
- 60-minute partner-led technical deep dive: demo of the Dedicated routing and marketplace routing policy, plus a short integration checklist for your onboarding team.

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Tue 16 Feb: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00 PT
- Wed 17 Feb: 09:00–10:00 PT

Ben (copied) will coordinate availability from our infra/solutions engineering team. I attached a short ops checklist and the itemized MVP list you mentioned — please review and flag anything missing.

If those windows don't work, send two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

1) How Dedicated routing differs when launched via a marketplace listing
2) Audit logs / retention options by customer segment
3) Integration steps so we can onboard 2 pilot accounts in Q2

I'll upload a short internal checklist to the shared doc link and add any additional asks. Attaching a one-page internal ops note as well.

Thanks —
